  • A535

PERFECT COLOuR MATCH, EVERY TIME

BOSTIK A535 ACRYL PARQUET

Achieve perfectly matched results with BOSTIK A535 ACRYL PARQUET sealant, specially designed for wooden floor joints.

Its durable, flexible seal effectively fills gaps and prevents cracks, while providing a smooth, professional finish. Ideal for both new projects and renovations, it enhances the beauty and extends the life of your wooden floors.

Explore our hardwood flooring solutions READ OUR BROCHURE

BENEFITS 

  • Quick drying time
  • High flexibility
  • Sandable for perfect finish
  • Available in 10 colours  

APPLICATIONS 

BOSTIK A535 ACRYL PARQUET is a premium, flexible acrylic sealant specially developed for sealing connection joints in parquet, laminate, and wooden flooring, as well as along baseboards. It ensures a quick and professional finish, seamlessly matching the floor colour.

Also ideal as a gap filler for wooden components, BOSTIK A535 ACRYL PARQUET offers excellent adhesion, easy application and is sandable and paintable once cured. Making it the perfect finishing touch for interior woodwork.

SHELF LIFE

In unopened original packaging between + 5°C and + 25°C, shelf life is up to 24 months from production date, stored in a dry place.
